description: Returns one bill by its identifier (32449): its description, its package, and every review stage in order, committee hearings and readings, with dates, yes and no counts, and the identifiers of its votes. Read a vote with parliament_get_vote. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

id.description: The identifier, from a search or a list, for example 32449.

name: parliament_get_bill

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the data, RFC 3339.

author.description: The body that drafted the bill.

initiator.description: The body that submitted the bill.

newest_reading.description: The reading code of the newest stage, when it is a reading.

newest_stage.description: The name of the newest review stage.

package_name.description: The name of the package of the bill.

registration_number.description: The registration number of the package.

source.description: The source of the data: Parliament of Georgia.

stages.description: Every review stage, in the order of the review.

bureau_date.description: The day of the sitting of the bureau, YYYY-MM-DD.

bureau_number.description: The number of the sitting of the bureau.

from.description: The first day of the review, YYYY-MM-DD.

name.description: The name of the stage at the Parliament.

reading.description: first_reading, second_reading, third_reading, single_reading, plenary_draft, alternative_proposal, or other. Empty for a committee stage.

session_date.description: The day of the plenary sitting, YYYY-MM-DD.

session_number.description: The number of the plenary sitting.

to.description: The last day of the review, YYYY-MM-DD.

votes.description: The identifiers of the votes of the stage.

stale.description: True when the Parliament did not answer and the server returns data it read before.

url.description: The page of the bill at the Parliament.

title: Get a bill of the Parliament of Georgia
